text:
Predicates:
LanguageGeneration(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
LanguageUnderstanding(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
NaturalLanguageProcessing(x) ::: x is a natural language processing task.
TextSequence(x) ::: x is a text sequence.
Output(x, y) ::: the output of x is y.
Premises:
∀x (NaturalLanguageProcessing(x) → LanguageGeneration(x) ⊕ LanguageUnderstanding(x)) ::: Natural language processing tasks can be categorized as either language generation task or language understanding task.
∀x (Output(x, textSequence) → LanguageGeneration(x)) ::: If the output of a natural language processing task is a text sequence, then it is a language generation task.
NaturalLanguageProcessing(machineTranslation) ::: Machine translation is a natural language processing task.
Output(machineTranslation, textSequence) ::: The output of machine translation is a text sequence.
Conclusion:
¬LanguageUnderstanding(machineTranslation) ::: Machine translation is not a language understanding task.
